sources.entry: Chevereto - Ultimate image sharing software. Create your very own personal image hosting website in just minutes. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: Chevereto is a self-hosted image and video sharing platform for building your own media-sharing website on your own server.
summary.what_it_does: Chevereto lets you run a media-sharing website on hardware you control, covering images, videos, categories, tags and albums. The README describes user accounts with registration, profiles, 2FA and roles, plus multi-user and multi-tenant support so one installation can host several independent sites. It lists CDN support, caching and image optimization for performance, along with an API for integration and translations in over 30 languages. Installation is described through Docker (multi-arch for x86_64 and arm64), VPS, cPanel, Plesk, and installers such as Installatron, Softaculous and SwiftWave. Updating and upgrading guides are linked for V2 and V3 users moving to V4.
use_cases: personal photo and video sharing site
host several sites from one installation
run an image host without platform restrictions
how_to_run: Download the latest 4.x.x.zip from the GitHub releases page, or use the direct download link
Install using the Docker guide (pure Docker or Chevereto Docker image)
Install on a VPS following the VPS guide
Alternatively use cPanel, Plesk, Installatron, Softaculous or SwiftWave
Follow the Updating guide to keep a V4 system current
notable: Multi-tenant: host multiple independent sites from a single installation
Dual licensing: AGPLv3 free edition plus a commercial proprietary license
Multi-arch Docker image for x86_64 and arm64
Built-in 2FA, roles and granular privacy controls
caveats: The README says AGPLv3 means network use counts as distribution, so modified deployments must share source with users
Chevereto Lite and Pro are proprietary editions under a separate license, and some features are tied to edition comparisons on the project's site
Requires a web server, PHP and a MySQL/MariaDB database
